$comment: Buildings programme Stage 3 / tuning T-1 — THE one tuning file of the reference-library generator (docs/DESIGN_Terrain_Combat_Tuning.md §2a). Every generated number comes from an ammo's driving parameters (ammo.json) and a weapon's (weapons.json) through these coefficients; tuning moves THESE and every type moves together. Deliberately simple engineering approximations — real TKB data always overrides.

kineticPenetration.$comment: pen (mm RHA) = k[type] · v (m/s) · sqrt(mass kg) — a DeMarre-style momentum form; v = the ammo's nominal velocity × the weapon's velocityFactor

shapedChargePenetration.$comment: pen (mm RHA) = coneFactor · calibre (mm), independent of velocity and range; an ammo may state its own coneFactor (an older warhead design)

highExplosivePenetration.$comment: the DIRECT penetration of an HE / fragmentation round on impact (its area effect is CE-1032): pen = factor · calibre

damage.$comment: kinetic: damage = perSqrtJoule · sqrt(½ m v²) (5.56 ball ⇒ ~25, the flat default); explosive types: damage = perKgExplosive · explosive kg

blast.$comment: Hopkinson–Cranz scaled distance: R = Z · W^(1/3), W = explosive kg TNT-equivalent; generated for CE-1032 (warheads), not read by the simulation yet
